heading: Rent statement
paragraphs: A rent statement has been created based on the information you have provided.
If a payment has been made for a period, you can add the details of this by selecting ‘Add a payment’ in the relevant row.
If this table is correct and no payments have been made for any of the periods, you can select ‘Save and continue’.
emptyTable: There are no rent periods to show. Check the rent and the period the statement covers.

problems.periodNotFound: That rent period is not in the statement
